claims.quote: Hyphessobrycon vilmae originates from the upper reaches of the Rio Tapajós in Brazil.
Hyphessobrycon vilmae is a small characid that appears to be endemic to the upper rio Tapajós basin in Amazonas and Mato Grosso states, Brazil.
